description: Distribution (min/p10/q1/median/q3/p90/max, std dev, histogram, nearest hospital per percentile) of one payer's rate for a (code_type, code) across hospitals, one figure per hospital; the payer-specific counterpart to get_code_provider_price_distribution. The filter must name every term the group_by grouping keeps, else INVALID_ARGUMENT. Pass plan_slug (from list_payer_plans) to distribute one plan's rates alone; MEDIAN is then only valid with GROUP_BY_PER_COMBINATION. Backed by the hospital-prices serving snapshot; fails with UNAVAILABLE until the server has opened one.

code_type.description: Code system the billing code belongs to, e.g. APR-DRG, CDM, CPT, HCPCS, MS-DRG, RC.

filter.description: Keeps only some of the grouped rows (see group_by). Each field left out matches any value; set a field (even to its *_UNSPECIFIED value, which means 'not filed') to require it. Billing classes are never blended: a facility fee and a professional fee are separate bills.

group_by.description: How a hospital's rates are grouped (default GROUP_BY_PER_COMBINATION: per billing class + methodology + setting). The filter must name every term the grouping keeps (GROUP_BY_ALL with no filter, GROUP_BY_BILLING_CLASS plus a billing_class, GROUP_BY_METHODOLOGY plus a methodology, per-combination all three), else INVALID_ARGUMENT. GROUP_BY_FACILITY_PLUS_PROFESSIONAL is not available for payer rates.

payer_slug.description: A payer_slug from list_payers or list_code_payers, e.g. "aetna".

plan_slug.description: Optional plan_slug from list_payer_plans: distribute that plan's rates alone (hospitals not filing the plan are left out). Empty means the payer as a whole.

reference_price.description: When positive, the response counts how many are priced strictly below it.

state.description: Optional two-letter USPS state code (e.g. "TX", case-insensitive): only hospitals with a location in that state are counted. A hospital in several states counts in each, so state figures can add up to more than national ones. Empty means every hospital; anything that is not a state code is rejected as INVALID_ARGUMENT.

name: get_code_payer_price_distribution
title: Get one payer's price distribution for a code
